message.content:
Here are some of the most famous American composers, spanning various eras and styles:

| Composer | Years | Notable Works / Contributions |
|----------|-------|--------------------------------|
| **George Gershwin** (1898–1937) | *Rhapsody in Blue*, *An American in Paris*, *Porgy and Bess* |
| **Aaron Copland** (1900–1990) | *Appalachian Spring*, *Fanfare for the Common Man*, *Rodeo* |
| **Leonard Bernstein** (1918–1990) | *West Side Story*, *On the Town*, *Candide* |
| **John Philip Sousa** (1854–1932) | “The Stars and Stripes Forever”, “The Washington Post March” |
| **Philip Glass** (born 1937) | Minimalist works like *Einstein on the Beach*, *Glassworks* |
| **Samuel Barber** (1910–1981) | *Adagio for Strings*, *Knoxville: Summer of 1915* |
| **Charles Ives** (1874–1954) | *The Unanswered Question*, *Central Park in the Dark* |
| **William Grant Still** (1895–1978) | *Afro-American Symphony*, *Bluebird* |
| **John Williams** (born 1942) | Film scores: *Star Wars*, *Indiana Jones*, *Jurassic Park* |
| **Stephen Sondheim** (1930–2021) | Musical theater: *Sweeney Todd*, *Into the Woods*, *Company* |

These composers have had a lasting impact on American music, from classical orchestral works to Broadway shows and film scores.
